scope_notice: Checks only the open-source VideoSeal v1.0 watermark. This does not detect all Meta-generated images and does not verify Meta's proprietary production watermark. A negative result does not establish authenticity or exclude AI generation.
limitations: One generated photographic scene plus three procedural controls; not a representative dataset.
Multiple messages and transforms of the same image are correlated.
No production Meta-watermark compatibility tested; no validated threshold.
